app.learn.bb.l1.title: Ị na-enweta ego n'ezie?
app.learn.bb.l1.story1: Aisha nwere obere ụlọ ahịa uwe. Taa ọ rere ₦50,000 wee laa n'ụlọ nwee obi ụtọ.
app.learn.bb.l1.story3: Ire ere na-adị ka ihe ịga nke ọma — mana ha bụ otu ihe na uru?
app.learn.bb.l1.chooseExplain: Ire ere abụghị otu ihe na uru. Ọ bụrụ na ọ mefuru ₦35,000 na ngwaahịa dị, uru ukwu bụ ₦15,000 (₦50,000 − ₦35,000).
app.learn.bb.l1.mathInsight: Uru ukwu na ire ere = ego batara − ihe ire ere ahụ furu gị.
app.learn.bb.l1.calcQ: Ị rere maka ₦10,000. Ọ furu gị ₦7,000. Gịnị bụ uru ukwu gị?
app.learn.bb.l2.title: Ire ere ≠ uru
app.learn.bb.l2.salesQ: Nọmba ole na-agwa gị ego ole ị rere?
app.learn.bb.l2.salesExplain: Ire ere bụ ego ndị ahịa kwụrụ gị — tupu ọnụ ahịa.
app.learn.bb.l2.profitQ: Nọmba ole na-agwa gị ihe fọdụrụ mgbe ọnụ ahịa gasịrị?
app.learn.bb.l2.profitExplain: Uru bụ ihe fọdụrụ mgbe ngwaahịa na ọnụ ahịa azụmahịa ndị ọzọ gasịrị.
app.learn.bb.l2.compareQ: Azụmahịa ole nwetara uru kachasị elu?
app.learn.bb.l3.title: Akwụkwọ ndetu gị bụ ebe nchekwa azụmahịa gị
app.learn.bb.l3.story1: Musa arụọla ụlọ ahịa ya afọ atọ.
app.learn.bb.l3.story2: Mmadụ jụrụ: “Ego ole ka ị nwetara ọnwa gara aga?”
app.learn.bb.l3.story3: Musa kwuru: “Echere m… ihe dị ka ₦300,000.”
app.learn.bb.l3.story4: Ncheta gị abụghị usoro ndekọ ego.
app.learn.bb.l3.insight: Ndị nwe na-ede ihe maara ihe na-eme n'ezie — ọ bụghị ihe ha na-eche.
app.learn.bb.l3.chooseQ: Ònye nwere ike ịma ihe na-eme na azụmahịa?
app.learn.bb.l3.chooseExplain: Ndekọ kwa ụbọchị na-emeri ncheta oge ọ bụla.
app.learn.bb.l3.missionHint: Dekọọ ire ere 5 na-esote gị na TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l4.title: Ire ere ọ bụla nwere akụkọ
app.learn.bb.l4.intro: Ndekọ ọma na-aza: gịnị ka ere, ego ole, mgbe, nye onye, otu ha si kwụọ, na ma ihe ọ bụla ka fọdụrụ ịkwụ.
app.learn.bb.l4.amountQ: Ị dere naanị “₦25,000” — nke ahụ ezuola?
app.learn.bb.l4.amountB: Mba — ndekọ zuru ezu na-akọ akụkọ ego ahụ
app.learn.bb.l4.amountExplain: Ego naanị anaghị agwa gị ngwaahịa, onye ahịa, ịkwụ ụgwọ, ma ọ bụ ụgwọ.
app.learn.bb.l4.checklist: Gịnị · Ego ole · Mgbe · Onye ahịa · Ụzọ ịkwụ ụgwọ · Kwụchara? · Ihe fọdụrụ ịkwụ?
app.learn.bb.l4.missionHint: Mepee Dekọọ → Ire ere ma chekwaa otu ire ere n'ezie na TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l5.title: Mepee ụlọ ahịa gị dị ka ọkachamara
app.learn.bb.l5.routine: Mmalite nkeji 5: ☑ Lelee ego · ☑ Ngwaahịa dị mkpa · ☑ Iwu taa · ☑ Ndị ahịa ji ụgwọ · ☑ Ebumnuche ire ere taa
app.learn.bb.l5.openQ: Ụlọ ahịa gị meghere. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme mbụ?
app.learn.bb.l5.openExplain: Nlele ngwa ngwa na-enyere gị aka ire ma zere ihe ijuanya.
app.learn.bb.l6.title: Ebee ka ego ahụ gara?
app.learn.bb.l6.story1: Aisha nwetara ₦80,000 na ire ere — mana naanị ₦15,000 fọdụrụ na mmechi.
app.learn.bb.l6.story2: Njem, nri, ngwaahịa dị, ọkụ eletrik, mmefu onwe, ndị ọrụ… ma ọ bụ amaghị?
app.learn.bb.l6.leaks: Ego nwere ike ịpụ site na ọnụ ahịa azụmahịa, ngwaahịa dị, ụgwọ, ma ọ bụ mmefu na-edekọghị.
app.learn.bb.l6.teach: Ọ bụrụ na ịdekọghị ebe ego na-aga, azụmahịa gị nwere ike ịlafu ego nwayọọ.
app.learn.bb.l6.missionHint: Dekọọ otu mmefu na TIJAR ka ị mara ebe ego gara.
app.learn.bb.l7.title: Ego azụmahịa ≠ ego onwe
app.learn.bb.l7.story1: Azụmahịa Musa nwere ₦100,000. Enyi kpọrọ ya ka ọ pụọ.
app.learn.bb.l7.story2: Ọ were ₦20,000 site na ego azụmahịa.
app.learn.bb.l7.withdrawExplain: Iwere ego ụlọ ahịa maka onwe gị abụghị ihe ọjọọ ozugbo — mana ị ga-ama ihe ọ bụ ma dekọọ ya nke ọma.
app.learn.bb.l7.teach: Kpọọ mwepụ na mmefu aha ka foto uru gị wee bụrụ eziokwu.
app.learn.bb.l8.title: Mechie ụlọ ahịa dị ka ọkachamara
app.learn.bb.l8.v1: Taa: Ire ere ₦75,000 · Mmefu ₦18,000 · Ụgwọ onye ahịa ₦12,000
app.learn.bb.l8.v2: Tupu ị kpọchie, nyochaa ihe mere.
app.learn.bb.l8.v3: Mmechi nke ọma = ihe ijuanya ole na ole echi.
app.learn.bb.l8.closeQ: Gịnị ka ị ga-enyocha tupu mmechi?
app.learn.bb.l8.closeA: Ire ere, mmefu, ego/ịkwụ ụgwọ, na ụgwọ onye ahịa
app.learn.bb.l8.closeC: Ọnweghị ihe — echi bụ ụbọchị ọzọ
app.learn.bb.l8.closeExplain: Mmechi nkeji 5 na-eme ka ndekọ na ego bụrụ eziokwu.
app.learn.bb.l8.closingList: Mmechi nkeji 5: 1) Dekọọ ire ere 2) Dekọọ mmefu 3) Lelee ego/ịkwụ ụgwọ 4) Lelee ụgwọ onye ahịa 5) Nyochaa arụmọrụ taa
app.learn.bb.l8.missionHint: Dekọọ opekata mpe otu ire ere taa ka edekọọ ụbọchị gị na TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l9.title: Azụmahịa gị nwere obi na-akụ
app.learn.bb.l9.intro: Azụmahịa ọ bụla nwere ọnụọgụ ole na ole ị ga-ama — na-enweghị okwu ndekọ ego siri ike.
app.learn.bb.l9.debtQ: Nọmba ole na-agwa gị ndị ahịa ka ji gị ụgwọ?
app.learn.bb.l9.debtExplain: Ụgwọ onye ahịa (ụgwọ) bụ ego a ka ji azụmahịa gị.
app.learn.bb.l10.title: Onye nwe azụmahịa nkeji 10
app.learn.bb.l10.intro: Ị nwere nkeji 10 tupu imepe. Họrọ ihe ise ụtụtụ dị mkpa.
app.learn.bb.l10.mBad: Leghara azụmahịa anya ruo mgbe onye ahịa batara
app.learn.bb.l10.evening: Usoro mgbede: dekọọ ire ere · dekọọ mmefu · dekọọ ụgwọ · lelee ịkwụ ụgwọ · nyochaa ụbọchị.
app.learn.bb.l10.levelComplete: Emechara ọkwa! Ị nwetara Onye Mmalite Azụmahịa 🏆 — Nweta Ego na ụzọ ndị ọzọ ga-emepe ka TIJAR na-eto.
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q1: Uru na otu ire ere ka akọwara nke ọma dị ka…
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q1a: Ego batara mwepu ihe ire ere ahụ furu gị
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q1b: Ihe ọ bụla fọdụrụ n'igbe ego n'abalị

app.learn.content.bbProfit.q3: Idekwọ ọnụ ahịa na ọnụ ahịa ire na-enyere gị aka…
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q3a: Kwụọ ụtụ isi karịa na ebumnuche
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q3b: Zoo ire ere n'ebe ndị ahịa nọ
app.learn.content.bbProfit.q3c: Hụ ngwaahịa ndị na-enweta ego n'ezie
app.learn.content.bbRecords.q1: Mgbe ị ga-edekọ ire ere na mmefu taa?
app.learn.content.bbRecords.q1b: N'otu ụbọchị ahụ, mgbe ị ka na-echeta
app.learn.content.bbRecords.q2a: Mara ma azụmahịa na-emeri ma ọ bụ na-efunahụ
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q1a: Ego na-abata ma na-apụ ka oge na-aga
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q1b: Naanị ego dị n'ụlọ akụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2: Ị nwere ike na-ere ọtụtụ mana ego gwụ gị ma ọ bụrụ na…
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2a: Ndị ahịa kwụrụ gị tupu ụgwọ gị eruo
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2b: Ire ere ụgwọ na-abata mgbe ụgwọ gị gasịrị
app.learn.content.finCashflow.q2c: Ị na-edekọ ire ere ọ bụla n'otu ụbọchị ahụ

app.learn.content.finSeparate.q2c: Jiri ụgwọ maka ihe niile naanị
app.learn.content.strPricing.q1: Ọnụ ahịa gị ga-ekpuchi opekata mpe…

app.learn.content.strPricing.q1c: Ihe ọ bụla onye ahịa chere
app.learn.content.strPricing.q2: Obere ndị ahịa mgbe niile na-ejikarị…

app.learn.content.audStock.q2a: Ị nwere ike nwee mfu, mmefu, ma ọ bụ ire ere na-edekọghị
app.learn.content.islTrade.q1b: Ngwaahịa doro anya, ọnụ ahịa doro anya, enweghị aghụghọ
app.learn.content.islTrade.q2a: Kwuo eziokwu banyere ihe onye ahịa nwetara
app.learn.content.islTrade.q2b: Gbanwee ọnụ ahịa mgbe ha kwụchara
app.learn.content.islRiba.q1c: Mgbakwunye na-ezighị ezi na ụgwọ ma ọ bụ ịkwụ ụgwọ egbu oge
app.learn.content.islRiba.q2: Maka ụgwọ ụlọ ahịa kwa ụbọchị, TIJAR na-enyere gị aka…
app.learn.content.islRiba.q2a: Soro ihe a ji na-enweghị aghụghọ ọmụrụ nwa ezoro ezo
